caption: The drawing depicts two blue oval-shaped hatboxes, one shown with its decorative top facing forward and the other with its lid off to display the side. The hatbox at the top has a cover featuring a painted scene with a man and a woman dressed in old-fashioned attire; both wear tall black hats, with the man in a brown coat and beige trousers and the woman in a light peach or off-white dress. Around them, there are several red and white flowers with green stems and leaves. At the base of the lid’s illustration, four small birds are evenly spaced, each bird facing to the right. The background of the decorated lid is blue. The lower part of the drawing shows the same box from a side view, revealing its blue-painted surface with various lighter areas, likely suggesting worn or aged paint. The composition places the two perspectives of the blue hatbox one above the other on a plain, beige background.
title: Pa. German Bandbox
